title: CPWD Strengthens Cleanliness and Administrative Efficiency through Special Campaign 6.0
body_text: Government of India announced Special Campaign 6 for which Preparatory Phase commenced from 15 th - 30 th September 2026 followed by implementation phase from 2 nd - 31 st October 2026. CPWD website and social media platforms were actively used to sensitize the Nodal Officers and CPWD Offices. CPWD designed a banner for Special Campaign 6, highlighting its key focus areas, for display at office premises, GPRA, GPOA and project sites across the country. CPWD offices undertook various initiatives under Special Campaign 6, reaffirming commitment to Swachhata. This year too, CPWD formulated a comprehensive action plan and set specific targets for improving overall cleanliness in GPRA and GPOA complexes, reducing pendency in references, ensuring effective space management and systematic review of records, with special emphasis on the proper disposal of e-waste. CPWD successfully implemented Special Campaign 6, and achieved the targets set across various focus areas, including cleanliness, effective record management, optimum space utilization and reduction in the pendency of references.
